summary: Humanity has come a long way. From simple tools to advanced spacecraft, we have always dreamed of exploring the unknown. But have we considered the consequences of our progress? We mainly wrote about this. In 1969, humans reached the Moon, proving that even our biggest dreams can become reality. In our story, it symbolizes curiosity, exploration, and the responsibility to protect space. We added some imagination to reality.
details: We did storytelling so we didn't use software and so on.
